sloka: यदि वाचं प्रदास्यामि द्विजातिरिव संस्कृताम् ।रावणं मन्यमाना मां सीता भीता भविष्यति ।वानरस्य विशेषेण कथं स्यादभिभाषणम् ।। ५.३०.१८।।।।
transliteration: yadi vācaṁ pradāsyāmi dvijātiriva saṁskṛtām ।rāvaṇaṁ manyamānā māṁ sītā bhītā bhaviṣyati ।vānarasya viśeṣeṇa kathaṁ syādabhibhāṣaṇam ।। 5.30.18।।।।

translations.english: "If I speak like a brahmin in sanskrit language she would be frightened thinking that I am Ravana and how would a vanara speak?
